title: Seelie-Unseelie wars
content:
A conflict that ended when a dryad mesmerised and led away the [[unseelie elves|unseelie]] (see [[hawthorn]] for more). How this relates to the exile of the unseelie alongside the [[Queen Sinister]] is unclear; whether it's a different event, a retelling, a conflicting account, etc.
